description: An account part-way through a migration to a hypothetical LogicalUsageV2. Two workspaces, one already shadow-recomputed. The case fixes what may be read and what may never be summed.
notes: The hypothetical V2 here is the alternative the CTO considered and rejected on 2026-09-05 — counting text in UTF-8 bytes instead of characters. It is used only to give the two versions different numbers; nothing here reopens it.
ws-1 holds vector 03's Japanese document, ws-2 holds vector 04's Arabic document.
Step 2 of the migration is complete for ws-1 and not for ws-2. The live components and the live aggregate are untouched, so every quota decision in flight is still answered by v1.
The forbidden answer is 236 (ws-1 at v2 plus ws-2 at v1). It is a number that is true under neither version, and no rounding, flag or 'best effort' makes it acceptable.
A component whose version differs from the aggregate's is refused on read, not coerced.

The switch is one transaction serialized by the same account-level quota authority that serializes reserve/finalize, so no durable receipt commits mid-switch. Until it commits, rollback is dropping the shadows.
The point of this case is unchanged by the 2026-09-05 decisions; only the numbers moved.
derivation: invariant: account.logical_usage_algorithm_version = 1, so every counted workspace component must read at version 1
ws-1: live component 41 at v1 (a v2 shadow of 115 exists and is not part of any total)
ws-2: live component 121 at v1 (no shadow yet)
after ws-2 is also shadowed, the switch transaction yields 115 + 208 = 323 at version 2

during_migration.rule: MIXED_VERSION_SUM_FORBIDDEN — a component whose version differs from the aggregate's is refused on read, never summed and never coerced

if_a_workspace_is_unknown_at_the_new_ver.rule: USAGE_UNKNOWN or CLOUD_SCHEMA_UPDATE_REQUIRED at vN+1 blocks the switch for the whole account; the migration retries. An account is never left half-migrated by a fault.

after_the_switch.rule: one transaction; components, aggregate and version stamps move together; shadows cleared

expected.customer_effect: No data is deleted and no durable receipt already issued is invalidated. An account the switch pushes over the pool behaves as any over-quota account: ACCOUNT_OVER_QUOTA on new durable receipts, local editing unaffected, the usage-reducing staging lane available.
